method: Public page/PDF text retrieval; no authenticated DrivenData session and no binary download from non-allowlisted official hosts

claims: Target: structures indicative of geothermal resources, namely faults. New faults not contained in the public USGS database were expert-labeled for initial test; expanded expert labels rescore final round.
Input GeoTIFF is UTM zone 11N / EPSG:32611 at 100 m resolution. Metric is distance-weighted Tversky with 300 m triangular support, alpha 0.2 and beta 0.8.
Submission: one float32 layer with pixel-wise confidence in [0,1], matching bounds; page says outside bounds null or NaN.
verified_readings.irregularity: Owner-mirrored sample has 60,988 ones (not all-zero absence despite page wording); our all-finite zero-outside policy is locally accepted by the shared validator but portal acceptance has NOT been verified.

verified_readings.source: Official GEMS Prize Rules, September 2026, sections 3.3–3.5
claims: Competition training features are a multiband 100 m GeoTIFF and existing fault pixels form training labels.
Competitors submit all-fault 100 m GeoTIFF predictions; up to three submissions per week, and select only one final set before the deadline.
Leaderboard is public test only; private test and expanded label set determine prize rounds.
verified_readings.irregularity: The PDF and live competition page should both be rechecked by the human selector before a slot; no authenticated weekly balance was read.

claims: Airborne magnetic and radiometric surveys were acquired to support geothermal and geologic mapping; data release marked CC0 1.0 Universal.
Area 1 and Area 2 had different flight-line spacing and nominal clearance; actual flight height may deviate in steep terrain and must be considered during interpretation.
verified_readings.use_limit: Survey metadata support a flight-line/terrain-clearance non-fault mimic; they do not verify any specific P5 predicted trace.

claims: Analytic-signal amplitude can peak over isolated magnetic contacts under stated assumptions; gradients are more susceptible to noise than horizontal gradients.
verified_readings.use_limit: A magnetic edge is not proof of fault displacement, permeability or temperature.

claims: USGS identifies SGMC as a state geologic map compilation and recommends a newer 2026 GeMS-schema release.
verified_readings.use_limit: Owner-derived, pinned 100 m SGMC raster is an imperfect independent-map PROXY response. Neither its current official release identity nor its ability to predict the hidden label distribution is authenticated here.

claims: Repository lists Quaternary faults, geothermal and geophysical layers; landing page marked CC BY 4.0.
verified_readings.use_limit: A listing or public URL is not proof the derived owner-mirror raster matches current official files or the hidden test.

claims: Public best displayed 0.4413 for participant xiaofanhu when read; it is a public-leaderboard snapshot, not a file-specific submission receipt or a P5 score.
verified_readings.use_limit: Public leaderboard is mutable; the 0.2778 H33 family claim remains USER-REPORTED until tied to an authenticated receipt.
